text:
{
  "name": "樹木劫掠&盔甲",
  "icon": "adorablehamsterpets:acorn_shard",
  "category": "adorablehamsterpets:advanced_rodentry",
  "entry_color": "00AAAA",
  "sortnum": 1,
  "pages": [
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "樹木劫掠&盔甲",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "若要獲得倉鼠盔甲，首先要將你的倉鼠$(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet)<dark_green><b>扔進</> 橡樹葉（或者在站在上面放下倉鼠）才能開始<dark_green><b>搜刮樹葉</>。$(br2)它們會鑽進樹葉裡，四處走動，然後最終叼著<dark_green><b>橡實</>出現在樹下，直到樹被薅禿。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "intro"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:spotlight",
      "title": "戰利品",
      "item": "adorablehamsterpets:acorn",
      "text": "<dark_green><b>橡實</>本身沒什麼用，除非你喜歡堆肥與噎到的風險。$(br2)用<b>切石機</>加工成$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>橡實殼碎片</>，可製作$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>盔甲</>，或時尚的$(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>橡實帽</>。",
      "anchor": "acorn"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:crafting",
      "recipe": "adorablehamsterpets:hamster_armor_acorn",
      "title": "硬菜沙拉",
      "text": "將橡實殼碎片與橡實帽組合，製作<dark_green><b>橡實製倉鼠鎧</>。$(br2)它會完全擋下攻擊傷害，直到耐久度耗盡。",
      "anchor": "acorn_armor"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:image",
      "title": "",
      "images": [
        "adorablehamsterpets:patchouli_books/hamster_tips_guide_book/images/acorn_armor/hamster_wearing_armor.png"
      ],
      "border": false,
      "text": "   就像狼鎧$(br)  ，但是更加$(br)  可愛。"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "魔力齧齒動物",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "堅果做的盔甲看上去就很豪華。如果用的是魔法堅果那就更棒了。$(br2)扔進附魔臺可以為其附上<b>耐久</>與<b>火焰保護</>附魔。$(br2)第二種附魔可以防止倉鼠實踐在巖漿游泳的想法時把自己烤熟。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "enchanting"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "多讀書",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "附魔書與鐵砧可以為盔甲增加<b>經驗修補</>，<b>冰霜行者</>以及<b>靈魂疾行</>。$(br2)<light_gray><i>注意：保護與摔落緩衝對倉鼠無效，因此不能加在盔甲上。盔甲本身已經為倉鼠提供防禦，且倉鼠無視摔落傷害。別太貪。</>",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "enchanting_advanced"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:smithing",
      "recipe": "adorablehamsterpets:hamster_armor_netherite_smithing",
      "title": "軍備升級",
      "text": "在戰利品寶箱找到<dark_green><b>倉鼠鍛造模板</>了？太好了。$(br2)使用鍛造臺，以珍貴材料升級<dark_green><b>倉鼠鎧</>。$(br2)每種材料都有……<i>獨特</>的優勢。",
      "anchor": "upgrades"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "一階升級效果",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "<light_gray><b>鐵：</>降低風阻，提高投擲速度。$(br)<gold><b>金：</>永久提升速度。$(br)<dark_purple><b>獄髓：</>讓倉鼠變得密實沉重，提供擊退抗性並大幅提高投擲傷害。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "perks"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "二階升級效果",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "<dark_aqua><b>鑽石：</>這是個相當昂貴的選擇。$(br2)將倉鼠用閃亮的石頭覆蓋；倉鼠覺得很棒。$(br2)倉鼠會開心到幫你拿東西而不是像之前那樣避開$(br)  它們。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "diamond_perk"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:image",
      "title": "",
      "images": [
        "adorablehamsterpets:patchouli_books/hamster_tips_guide_book/images/acorn_armor/hamsters_wearing_diamond_armor.png"
      ],
      "border": false,
      "text": "   <light_gray><i>我和小倉鼠$(br)  在備戰</>"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "橡實經濟",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "樹木是有記性的。同一棵橡樹被搜刮太多次，就不再提供戰利品。$(br2)生態系大約要一天才會原諒你。$(br2)等不及？使用重設$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands#reset_tree_heist)<b>指令</>，或設定中的$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>按鈕</>。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "economy"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "市場操縱",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "覺得大自然太摳搜？我在$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>設定介面</>裡給你新增了一個新的功能。$(br2)調高“橡實掉落機率”可以享受橡實雨（限制：每秒至多掉落一顆）。$(br2)當然揹包爆滿的時候可別來怪我。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "config"
    }
  ]
}

      "text_color": "000000"
    },

      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "基因釋讀者",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "倉鼠的父母會將它們的體色傳給後代。$(br2)父母顏色越接近 = 後代顏色越相像。反之 = 越不相像。$(br2)組合 <u>{TOTAL_WILD_VARIANTS}</> 種野生倉鼠，探索繁殖出所有 <u>{TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS}</> 種不同的樣子。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "罕見的紅眼",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "部分顏色偏淡的野生倉鼠有可能會長著一雙紅眼睛。你同樣可以透過繁殖得到紅眼倉鼠。$(br2)別盯著看它，或者隨你的便，我又不給你幹活。",
      "text_color": "000000"

    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "叛逆倉鼠",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "幼崽自打出生便有良好家教，把你當做陌生人（除非你在設定裡$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>關閉</>）。$(br2)$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>馴服</>它們可以快速認親。$(br2)如果想分給朋友小倉鼠，你就可以讓他們喂倉鼠。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },

      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "加速生長",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "喂倉鼠可以加快它們的生長。小時候的它們還不是很$(l:the_hamster_life/feeding#pickiness)<dark_green><b>挑食</>。$(br2)注意：馴服後，成年之前它們仍然會跟隨父母。可以用 $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>{LURE_ITEM}</> 把它們拐走。",
      "text_color": "000000"

      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",

text:
{
  "name": "管理員命令",
  "icon": "minecraft:command_block",
  "category": "adorablehamsterpets:the_kitchen_drawer",
  "entry_color": "00AAAA",
  "sortnum": 3,
  "pages": [
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "spawn_hamster",
      "header": "/ahp spawn",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "供那些想打破自然法則的人使用。$(br2)輸入 <b>/ahp spawn hamster</>，生成你想要的任意毛色倉鼠。$(br2)指令支援自動補全，省得你手動輸入全部 {TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS} 種可能的組合。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "spawn_all_bases",
      "header": "...spawn_all_bases",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "接下來兩條指令可分組展示倉鼠種類。$(br2)預設只生成 {BASE_PALETTES} 種基礎毛色。可在末尾加入 true（啟用）或 false（停用）引數，以疊加更多遺傳組合，或依作者名稱篩選材質。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "performance_mode",
      "header": "效能模式",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "在此之前你得先了解一下 <dark_green><b>效能模式</>。$(br2)這個模式下，所有紋理與幾何都會被去除，把倉鼠變成高效方正的生物。可以在 <b>控制</> 設定中切換自訂熱鍵。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "spawn_all_bases_2D",
      "header": "_all_bases_2D",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "將倉鼠按其數學上的立體顏色區間，系統性地修整為平面網格，便於你在$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>馴服</>時更容易接近它們。$(br2)$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>馴服</>能“叫醒”它們，重新啟用它們的 人工智慧。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "spawn_all_bases_3D",
      "header": "_all_bases_3D",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "將倉鼠懸空生成。它們在 3D 空間中的位置分別表示毛色的色調、飽和度與亮度。$(br2)這個由倉鼠構成的圓柱形可以幫你預測一對倉鼠繁育後代的$(br)   毛色。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "optional_arguments_1",
      "header": "引數 其一",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "將<b>野生毛色</>設定為 <b>啟用</> 可以看到所有 {TOTAL_WILD_VARIANTS} 種野生變體。$(br2)設定<b>取樣繁殖毛色</> 設定為 <b>啟用</> 可以看到三種繁殖毛色的樣本，一共是 {TOTAL_WILD_PLUS_BREEDING_SAMPLE_VARIANTS} 種變體。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "optional_arguments_2",
      "header": "引數 其二",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "設定 <b>匹配玩家視角</> 使得它們在拍照時跟你一同轉頭。$(br2)設定<b>隨機坐下</>與/或<b>瞌睡</>為 啟用 可以讓它們展現出更多動作。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "genetics_visualizer",
      "header": "基因顯示器",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "手持這本寶典時，在立體介面右鍵點選兩隻倉鼠可以檢視它們的後代。$(br2)管理員可以用箭頭調整基因多樣性及突變率。改動會立即儲存到設定並應用，$(br)   且全服有效。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "spawn_random_group",
      "header": "/spawn_random_group",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "生成隨機且互不重複的倉鼠。將 <b><count></> 設為數量，或使用 <b>all</> 生成所有可能組合。$(br2)警告：<b>all</> 會生成 {TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS} 隻倉鼠，可能<red><b>永久毀掉</>你的世界。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "undo_last_spawn",
      "header": "/undo_last_spawn",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "不小心在你的臥室裡召喚了一大團倉鼠？$(br2)這個命令可以讓上一次命令中生成的倉鼠全部消失。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "print_genetics_report",
      "header": "/print_genetics",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "強制基因引擎重新計算，並將其當前三維空間與包含的毛色計算傳送到<b>日誌</>或<b>聊天欄</>。$(br2)非常適合除錯$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>設定檔案</>改動後的結果，便於更快速地檢視倉鼠型別而$(br)   無需手動繁殖。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "set_age",
      "header": "/set_age",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "穿越時空。按年、月或日調整倉鼠的年齡。附帶命令自動補全。$(br2)如果你剛升級到 v3.6.0，舊倉鼠的年紀會顯示成<i>0 天</>。如果沒有看向附近的倉鼠使用這條命令，那麼會自動選擇離你最近的倉鼠。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "reset_player_breeding",
      "header": "/...breeding_history",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "<b>/reset_player</>$(br2)清理你的倉鼠繁殖記錄。$(br2)如果伺服器啟用了繁殖限制，且你已經達到了$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>設定</>中的上限，那麼你可以使用這個命令重置。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "reset_hamster_breeding",
      "header": "/...breeding_history",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "<b>/reset_hamster</>$(br2)倉鼠有一個$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>可自由設定</> 的繁殖數量上限。$(br2)這會將附近倉鼠的繁殖上限調回零，便於再次進行繁殖。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "reset_tree_heist",
      "header": "/reset_tree_economy",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "中和本地生物羣系。$(br2)所有樹木會立刻失去$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#intro)<dark_green><b>你用倉鼠掏空它們</>的記憶，並準備再次饋贈。$(br2)生養我們的大地竟然如此心胸寬廣。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "anchor": "redstone_fever",
      "header": "/redstone_fever",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "讓管理員對最近的倉鼠施加熱病或治癒。可加上實體選擇器，同時處理多隻倉鼠。$(br2)使用這些指令不會獲得熱病相關成就。",
      "text_color": "000000"
    }
  ]
}
